title: TypeError: unhashable type: 'list' when a Pandas DataFrame contains a list using st.cache
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

Looking at https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/111 it looks like hashing a DataFrame where any value was a list used to cause problems. However, it was fixed and it's working now.

However, if you have two cached functions and one is using the result of the other, the problem comes back.

In 1.42 this doesn't raise an exception, but since 1.43 it does.

### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
import pandas as pd
import streamlit as st


[USER].cache_data
def get_df1():
    df1 = pd.DataFrame({"col": [[1, 2]]}, index=[1])
    print(df1)
    return df1


[USER].cache_data
def get_df2(df1):
    df2 = pd.DataFrame({"col2": [42]}, index=[1])
    print(df2)

    return pd.merge_asof(df1, df2, left_index=True, right_index=True)


df1 = get_df1()
df2 = get_df2(df1)
print(df2)
```

_No response_

_No response_

### Is this a regression?

- [x] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Python version: 3.13
- Operating System: Fedora 41
- Browser: Firefox 136.0.3
